steps: ok the top folder is listed (2 entries)
ok search finds notes.txt by name, ignoring case
ok notes.txt reads with its size and revision (17 bytes)
ok a path outside the folder is refused

features.name: preferences
steps: ok a save is answered
ok a save reaches another socket's subscription
ok a later subscription gets the saved value

features.name: rows
steps: ok the socket from 0 sent 12 rows
ok every row's prevSeq is the row before it, and seqs only rise (1 skip past deleted deltas)
ok the socket reaches the newest row (14)
ok the socket from 6 starts at 7 with prevSeq 6

features.name: scm
steps: ok worktrees/list answers the main checkout first
ok git/status answers the branch and changed files
ok git/diff answers a file's staged and working tree diffs

features.name: session-view
steps: ok the header's keyed topic sends the session, with no parent session
ok a working session carries its run (the column draws its dot)
ok the run goes from the session when the turn ends (the dot goes)
ok the first rows page has 7 rows, hasBefore and no active run
ok an opened tool call reads its detail
ok the Context tab lists the 0 files the session's tool calls changed
ok the Context tab lists no attachments, on this machine
ok the sessions column lists the session

features.name: sessions-list
steps: ok a new session is in Working
ok the rail lists the session under its provider and location, and its totals count it
ok while its turn runs, Running lists the session and counts it
ok Mark done stamps completedAt
ok sessionRail names the session when it moves
ok Settle stamps settledAt and keeps the done time
ok a settled session pages with Settled, not with the open ones
ok a settled session leaves the rail
ok Back to working clears both stamps
ok back in Working, it is in the rail again
ok Connect has no remote to reach here
ok once its turn has ended, Running no longer lists the session
